textSeparation: UI labels, dynamic numbers, prices, names, dates and errors are native text. Icon and skin PNGs contain no textual labels.
fallbackPolicy: Resolve first installed CJK font in stack; if unavailable, show missing font diagnostic and use OS CJK fallback. Do not download fonts silently.

layoutRules.wrap: body paragraphs may wrap by grapheme; buttons single line; tooltip wraps
layoutRules.overflow: measure actual selected font; ellipsis with full-text tooltip for list names; never crop price/score/status
layoutRules.buttonAutoFit: never reduce below24; expand button or shorten product-approved text
layoutRules.numeralPolicy: tabular figures where available; keep separators and signs explicit
layoutRules.localization: remeasure text bounds after locale change
layoutRules.license: No third-party font files shipped; confirm font licensing if bundling later

validationRequired: Installed font resolution per target OS
No overflow at 2560x1080 and minimum supported viewport
Contrast of ivory on jade and jade on ivory

currentWindowsProbe.scope: Current host file availability only; no font files bundled, no cross-platform guarantee
